biblical_reference.note: The name Rebecca appears in the Old Testament of the Bible. It was the name of the wife of Isaac and the mother of Jacob and Esau. The name means 'drawing near' or 'one who draws near' in Hebrew, and it was given to Rebekah because the Lord had called her to be the mother of the chosen people.
